scope: saved microbench binary disassembly and frozen source only

copy.loop: 0x0160 @!P0 BRA 0xa0, index increment gridDim.x*blockDim.x and 64-bit n comparison
copy.work: one 32-bit read plus one 32-bit write per element; logical work=n*8 bytes, not measured DRAM bytes

fma.main_loop: 0x02a0 decrements R6 by 4; 32 FFMA through 0x04b0; 0x04c0 branches to 0x02a0
fma.remainder_loop: 0x04e0 decrements iterations modulo 4 by 1; eight FFMA; branch at 0x0580
fma.work_formula: n * iterations * 8 FMA * 2 FLOPs; excludes input multiply, final 7 adds and address/control instructions
fma.output: seven FADD reductions then 0x0620 STG.E; every chain contributes

resources.spill_observation: resource LOCAL/STACK zero and no LDL/STL instructions in saved SASS; PTX virtual register counts are not hardware allocated registers

limitations: Instruction inspection supports operation count, not saturation or a sustainable peak.
Five batches in one run, uncontrolled clocks, no independent-session stability proof.
Only first 16 outputs checked after warmup; formal timed samples not fully numerically validated.
Assembly extraction manifest binds supplied binary/hash; does not independently prove build provenance or execution exclusivity.
